{{Quote|I looked up from my research and found myself looking at Lutris Lake, and I don't have a window. My whole wall was gone by the time I could tell anyone.|Zobyteeg|<ref name="HNN53">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|regional/13425_2.html|Tynna to Secede Following Building Disappearance}}</ref>}}
'''Lutris Lake''' was a body of [[Water/Legends|water]] situated in [[Lutris]] on<ref name="HNN53" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]]. The [[Tynna Central Government Building]] was located within viewing distance of the lake.<ref name="HNN53" /> Shortly before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|onset]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="CSWE Razelfiin">{{CSWECite|III|84|Razelfiin}}</ref> between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[General Council Assistant]] [[Zobyteeg]] was working on research at the Tynna Central Government Building when he caught sight of Lutris Lake despite the fact that his immediate environment did not feature a [[Viewport/Legends|window]]. The happenstance came about as a result of a [[Stone mite/Legends|stone mite]] infestation, which had caused the wall to collapse.<ref name="HNN53" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lutris Lake was mentioned on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]] in the [[in-universe]] issue [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 53|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #53'']], published<ref name="HNN53" /> on [[April 25]], [[2002]]<ref name="HNN53 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6586618|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=Mastadge|date=2002-04-25|time=5:54 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-13}}</ref> and written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
